green600.usage: primary accent — buttons, links, brand mark

green400.usage: accent on dark surfaces, hover state

rule: Ink flips to white on dark surfaces. Haus Green never changes hue across light or dark mode — it is the one constant brand signal. Neutrals are crisp near-black on true white (cool grey scale), not the original warm charcoal/cream — changed per direct feedback that the warm tones read as murky on screen. The accent is a moss green with real saturation, not a washed-out pastel or a clean synthetic 'SaaS' green — earthy and confident, not corporate.
